reason: The game's own explanation of the words. Machine substitution turns it into a contradiction - "Zenar means, roughly, 'not our ancestors'" is false, since that is what mortals call them and not what they call themselves. Hand-written instead, and it is where the Daedra/Zenar distinction is taught. 81 copies in 45 places, including the Balmora bookseller.
Tarer Braryn's copy of the same book, same text, same reason. Excluding one and not the other would leave a copy that contradicts the other.
Caius Cosades, topic 'little advice'. The vanilla line already lists Daedra among what to look out for; hand-written so he flags the word as worth asking about instead of merely using it.
Caius Cosades, topic 'Blades'. His account of the trade, extended with the spymaster's point: what a province calls a thing tells you who is doing the calling.
